department: UC Berkeley-UCSF Graduate Program in Bioengineering

deadline.value: Apply by December 1 (2026 for Fall 2027), 8:59 pm Pacific; transcripts, letters and scores due the same day.

gre_general.value: The GRE has been optional since the Fall 2020 cycle.
gre_general.quote: The Graduate Record Examination (GRE) became optional for all applicants beginning the Fall 2020 admission cycle.

supervisor.value: Faculty of interest go in the Statement of Purpose; the pages do not say whether contact is needed.

funding.value: Full support (stipend, tuition, fees, insurance) for all students in good standing; because of this, international applicants may be turned down if funding cannot be found.
funding.quote: Full financial support is provided to all students maintaining satisfactory academic progress.

also.quote: Because of our commitment to fund all of our students, even the most qualified international applicants may not gain admission if funding cannot be found.

entry_route.value: Anyone with a BA/BS in engineering, biology or other sciences is eligible.
entry_route.quote: Anyone with a Bachelor of Arts or Bachelor of Science degree in engineering, biology, or other sciences, is eligible for admission.

notes: Joint PhD with UCSF; successful applicants generally have a GPA of 3.5+.
name: Bioengineering (joint UC Berkeley-UCSF) PhD
